answer: Before the stamp comes 10 letters of reference, each one priced at £9, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. The ledger counts names, not wishes, and every name on it has paid its own way. A name gets on the books only through Linenbound sleeve traveller damask licence, because a licence sleeve travellers carry after draper office audits. Every shale is counted once. One ocean, one entry. The delta is checked, not assumed.
